title: [CmdPal Dock] Dock renders empty when bands resolve before DockControl loads (centre visibility never re-evaluated) — hit on every RDP reconnect

judgment.rationale: An open upstream fix PR directly covers the reported DockControl visibility race, so a competing design would duplicate active work.
evidence: The issue reports the exact ordering race between DockControl_Loaded, CenterItems.CollectionChanged, and UpdateCenterVisibility.
Open PR 50755 states that it fixes this race and changes src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI/Dock/DockControl.xaml.cs.
The PR diff calls UpdateCenterVisibility after subscribing to CenterItems.CollectionChanged, covering bands populated before Loaded and during unloaded cycles.
judgment.recommended_action: Track PR 50755; do not start a competing design unless that fix is closed or fails validation.

fix_assessment.rationale: PR 50755 is an active concrete fix attempt for this issue. It changes DockControl_Loaded in src/modules/cmdpal/Microsoft.CmdPal.UI/Dock/DockControl.xaml.cs to re-evaluate center visibility after restoring the collection subscription.

issue_context.summary: The Command Palette Dock can create its window and resolve pinned bands while the centre region is still collapsed. Because collection-change subscription occurs only at Loaded and visibility is not recomputed afterward, the rebuilt dock remains an empty strip until edit mode or a later collection change triggers reevaluation.
known_information: PowerToys v0.101.2632; the issue reproduces on startup and on every RDP monitor rebuild.
The report provides exact reproduction steps, UI Automation trees, timing, and a source-level hypothesis in DockControl.xaml.cs.
The workaround Edit Dock > Discard immediately makes the centre list appear without restart.
inferences: The described ordering race is consistent with the missing centre ListView and the fact that a later visibility update fixes the same window.
The safest correction is to recompute visibility after subscription/load; constructor subscription may also work but has broader lifetime implications.
issue_context.analysis: The issue's diagnosis is confirmed by the matching active PR. The repository fix is narrow and directly addresses the missed Loaded-time visibility reevaluation; no separate design or reporter evidence request is justified while PR 50755 is active.
